metas.name: Aasiaat Snowmobile
metas.note: The most noticeable feature of the coverage in Aasiaat is the windshield with a shiny red, white and black reflection. The large, round side mirrors can also be used to identify the town. The coverage is very sunny and has thick, thawing snow along most of the roads.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: All White Boat
metas.note: This large, all white boat can be seen in between Narsarsuaq with the opposing shore.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Blue Roof Boat
metas.note: A black and white boat, with a blue roof, is found between the towns of Kuummiit and Tasiilaq.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Boat with Black Box
metas.note: A boat with a black box near the front, and a chequered pattern on the bow can be found fairly north on the east coast. While the western part of the coverage is very foggy and somewhat overcast, the eastern parts of the coverage is slightly less foggy and very sunny. A man wearing a black coat can also be seen captaining the boat.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Boat with Brown Wooden Top
metas.note: This small white boat, with a brown wooden top and lights and monitoring devices, can be seen between Tiilerilaaq and Tasiilaq.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Boat with Extrem Tall Antennas
metas.note: A mostly white boat, with extremely tall antennas on the rear can be found going into the fjord east of Nuuk.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: East Nuuk
metas.note: On a small bit of coverage east of Nuuk you can see a large number of sharp mountains, powdered in snow. The coverage is somewhat dark due to the thick clouds and the sun being hidden behind the mountains.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Grey Boat
metas.note: A grey boat is found east of Nuuk.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Igaliku ATV
metas.note: The coverage in and around Igaliku is most easily recognized by the wide, snow-covered mountain range to the northeast which looks very bright due to the setting sun. The green ATV, while not entirely unique on its own, can also be a useful hint.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Ikerasak Mountains
metas.note: Ikerasak is most easily recognized by the large monolithic mountain to the west.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Ilulissat Beige Hat
metas.note: Most coverage in Ilulissat can be recognized by the green ATV with black bars and the driver wearing a beige hat. Note however that there are some small sections where the driver does not wear it. The coverage is fairly sunny and bright.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Ilulissat Blond Hair
metas.note: The Guy with the Beige Hat in Ilulissat has also blonde Hair at some coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Ittoqqortoormiit Wooden Box
metas.note: Most coverage in Ittoqqortoormiit can be recognized by the brown wooden box at the front of the ATV and the driver wearing a purple beanie. The ground is mostly grey and stony and the coverage is very sunny.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kangaatsiaq Snow
metas.note: Kangaatsiaq has a large amount of thawing snow on the side of the roads. The sun is setting and there is a large body of water to the west.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kangerluk Mountains
metas.note: Kangerluk can be recognized by the evenly tall mountains with a particular shape on the other side of the fjord.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kangerlussuaq Car
metas.note: The road east of Kangerlussuaq is easily recognized by the large white truck.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kangerlussuaq Streaky Clouds
metas.note: Kangerlussuaq can typically be recognized by the many streaky clouds in the sky, combined with the significant dryness. The roads near Kangerlussuaq can also be recognized by its unconventional look, with many small bushes, sandy soil with an almost arid climate.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kapisillit Car
metas.note: A red and black ATV can be found in and around the village of Kapisillit, northeast of Nuuk. Many mountains in the distance are covered in a layer of snow.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kulusuk ATV
metas.note: The coverage on Kulusuk island has a round, red ATV, with a pyramid shaped mountain often seen to the northeast. The footage was taken right after sunset on a clear day, making it fairly dark.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kulusuk Pyramid Mountains
metas.note: The coverage on Kulusuk island has a round, red ATV, with a pyramid shaped mountain often seen to the northeast. The footage was taken right after sunset on a clear day, making it fairly dark.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kuummiit Mountains
metas.note: Kuummiit can be recognized by two distinct mountains, a sharp one to the east and a rounder one to the north. The coverage is slightly dark due to clouds and the sun setting.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Maniitsoq Car
metas.note: The coverage in Maniitsoq was taken by a tractor, making it very recognizable. The coverage is overcast and fairly snowy.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Narsaq Antenna
metas.note: Narsaq can be identified by the thin antenna seen on the right side of the car. The coverage is very sunny and fairly green.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Narsarsuaq Black Hoodie
metas.note: The coverage in Narsarsuaq can be recognized by the driver wearing a black hoodie. The coverage was taken close to sunset on a very sunny day. There is also a fair amount of small bushes along the road, which is somewhat unusual in Greenland.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Narsarsuaq Orange Bag
metas.note: On the other side of the fjord from Narsarsuaq, a black ATV with an orange and purple bag in the front can be seen. The coverage has a lot of tall green grass and the dirt is unusually red for Greenland.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Niaqornat Mountains
metas.note: Large, dark grey rocks towering over Niaqornat can be used to recognize the village.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: North East Of Nuuk
metas.note: About 20 km northeast of Narsarsuaq, you can find a small piece of coverage with large ice blocks in every direction.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Nuuk Grey Car
metas.note: While Nuuk is most easily recognized by the grey Street View car, it can also be recognized by being the largest city by far.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Nuuk Tunnel
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Paamiut ATV
metas.note: Paamiut can typically be recognized by the round, grey car which is often only barely visible. The coverage has a lot of thin clouds, but is still quite bright and the foliage consists of a mixture of yellow and green grass, and reddish moss.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Qaanaaq Reflect Mountains
metas.note: To the southwest of Qaanaaq, you can see icebergs in a large body of water, and a wide mountain range on the other side, where the snow is bright white as it reflects the sunlight through the thick clouds.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Qaqortoq Car
metas.note: Qaqortoq can be recognized by the red rectangular car. The coverage is extremely sunny and the area is greener and less barren than most of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Qeqertarsuaq ATV
metas.note: Qeqertarsuaq is most easily recognized by the blue ATV with wide side mirrors. The coverage is fairly overcast and with a lot of yellow grass along the roads.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Red Black Boat
metas.note: This small, red and black boat, with multiple people sitting in it, can be found in a fjord far north on the east coast.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Red Boat
metas.note: This bright red boat can be found on the east coast near the towns of Tiilerillaq and Kuummiit respectively. While the coverage near Tiilerillaq does not have a cloud in sight, the coverage near Kuummiit is somewhat overcast.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Red Cabin Boat
metas.note: Similar to the previous boat, this one with a red square cabin can be found at multiple locations on the west coast, most significantly by and around Akunnaaq.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Red Roof Boat
metas.note: This boat, with a white cabin and a red roof, can be found by a multitude of towns and villages on the west coast. However, most of the coverage is in the general area around the city of Aasiaat.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Rounded Red Boat
metas.note: A small, rounded red bow can be found on a boat going south of Tasiilaq.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Saattut Clouds Mountains
metas.note: To the north of Saattut you can see a wide mountain range shrouded in clouds, on the other side of a fjord. The paths covered are mostly dark, muddy dirt roads, and the foliage is mainly yellow grass tufts.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Siorapaluk Beach
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Siorapaluk Sandy Mountains
metas.note:
Siorapaluk can be recognized by the sandy, pyramid-shaped mountains to the north, combined with the wide sand beach below the village.

NOTE: Look for the store named “Pilersuisoq” to locate the village, as you have to zoom in very far on Google Maps to see the label of the village.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Sisimiut Snowmobile
metas.note: The city of Sisimiut can be easily recognized by the black snowmobile with side mirrors pointing straight up. The coverage is generally very overcast and grey.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Sisimiut To Kangeriussuaq
metas.note: The coverage connecting Sisimiut and Kangerlussuaq is easily recognized by the thick layer of snow on and around the road. The sun sets along the road, making the western parts very bright and the eastern parts very dark.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Small Boat with silver Handrail
metas.note: This small, white boat with a silver handrail on the bow can be found west of Narsaq and east of Qaqortoq. While the sun is in the west on the coverage near Narsaq, it is in the east on the coverage near Qaqortoq.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Tasiilaq Snowmobile
metas.note: The coverage in Tasiilaq can be recognized by the ATV with large grey handguards on either side. The coverage has a lot of very thin clouds and the area is somewhat green.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Tiilerilaaq Grey Houses
metas.note: Unlike most houses in Greenland, the houses in Tiilerilaaq are commonly grey rather than colourful. The village can also be recognized by the ground, which is almost entirely made up of smooth, light grey rocks.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Ukkusissat Mounatins
metas.note: Ukkusissat is located below a tall cliffside to the east with mountains towering above it.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Upernavik Runway
metas.note: In Upernavik, the airport runway is covered on Street View, making it by far the widest paved road found on Street View in Greenland.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Uummannaq Snowmobile
metas.note: Uummannaq has two distinctive features: a sharp mountain to the north and a green snowmobile with large black side mirrors. Neither of the two can be seen on all coverage but at least one can be seen on most.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Wooden Fishing Boat
metas.note: This wooden fishing boat is found outside Ilulissat.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.
